text:
Although your name is tender as a kiss

and gives off fragrance like spilled oil,

and your memory is sweet and desired,

a rich feast for the senses and enchantment;


and it is glory and light, Love, to carry it imprinted

like a seal drawn upon the soul,

all that is not enough for the enamored heart

to reach life.


Only now, Love, lost in your embraces,

beside your breast will it halt its striving:

it will not loosen the nets and bonds,


nor see peace nor enjoy sleep,

until it has peace between your arms

and sleeps in the lap of its Master.

translation.title: Although Your Name Is Tender as a Kiss
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the devotional-erotic seal, bonds, and final rest in the Master's lap.
